missions.name: FIRST LINES
missions.hint: Clear five lines. Any size counts.

missions.name: TEN UP
missions.hint: Ten lines, two minutes.

missions.name: ONE AT A TIME
missions.hint: Five clears of exactly one line.

missions.name: TWO BY TWO
missions.hint: Four doubles. Singles do not count.

missions.name: TRIPLE THREAT
missions.hint: Three triples.

missions.name: FOUR WIDE
missions.hint: Three tetrises. Dig the well.

missions.name: THE FULL CYCLE
missions.hint: One clear of every size: 1, 2, 3 and 4.

missions.name: DIG OUT
missions.hint: Six rows of garbage to start. Clear eight lines.

missions.name: CHAIN GANG
missions.hint: Reach a four-combo. Clear on consecutive pieces.

missions.name: SPOTLESS
missions.hint: Empty the whole board once.

missions.name: STEADY HAND
missions.hint: Place forty pieces without topping out.

missions.name: HOLD ON
missions.hint: Survive one minute at speed.

missions.name: BLIND NEXT
missions.hint: Six lines with no preview.

missions.name: FADING STACK
missions.hint: Blocks vanish after five seconds. They are still there.

missions.name: BIG TROUBLE
missions.hint: Every piece is BIG. Four lines.

missions.name: SPIN CLASS
missions.hint: Two T-spin line clears.

missions.name: TURNTABLE
missions.hint: The piece turns by itself. Five lines.

missions.name: AGAINST THE CLOCK
missions.hint: Twenty lines in two minutes.

missions.name: DEEP DIG
missions.hint: Ten rows of garbage, twelve lines, three minutes.

missions.name: CLIMB TO 100
missions.hint: Reach level 100.

missions.name: BACK TO BACK
missions.hint: Two tetrises in a row. A smaller clear resets the count.

missions.name: SPIN DOCTOR
missions.hint: One T-spin double.

missions.name: FAST CYCLE
missions.hint: Every clear size, at speed, in two and a half minutes.

missions.name: BIG BLIND
missions.hint: BIG pieces and no preview.

missions.name: GHOST STACK
missions.hint: Blocks vanish in two and a half seconds. Eight lines.

missions.name: ENDURANCE
missions.hint: Two minutes at 20G.

missions.name: HUNDRED PIECES
missions.hint: A hundred pieces in three minutes.

missions.name: PERFECT TWICE
missions.hint: Empty the board twice in one run.

missions.name: SPIN AND VANISH
missions.hint: Three T-spin clears with the stack disappearing.

missions.name: THE LAST WORD
missions.hint: Three tetrises in a row, no preview, four minutes.
